subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should Control UI channel viewing stop at the current Sessions-page Group by channel behavior, or should OpenClaw add a first-class separated/merged channel conversation timeline toggle?
rationale: Current main covers channel grouping, but the requested merged timeline and separated tab mode require UX, privacy, and Gateway/session semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
options.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and define the separated view, merged timeline, and routing/privacy semantics before implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Enough
options.body: Close the remaining request if maintainers decide the current Group by channel plus per-session chat links is the intended Control UI surface.

options.title: Limit to sidebar grouping
options.body: Accept only lightweight channel grouping such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89044 for now and defer merged timeline work.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and define the separated view, merged timeline, and routing/privacy semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current-main implementation and docs update for channel grouping came through steipete's recent Control UI session grouping work.
